sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS applications FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.cases c ON c.case_id = d.case_id WHERE d.outcome = 'ask_applicant' AND d.reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND d.reviewed_at < DATE '2026-11-01'
explanation: Applications with an ask_applicant outcome in October 2026.
assumptions: Sent back means the outcome ask_applicant
